searchText: what does this part from the EIP-4844 spec mean? ```On the consensus layer the blobs are referenced, but not fully encoded, ``` during the gossip period, which is when the blob is a blob sidecar, the spec says that the blob tx is wrapped to become `rlp([tx_payload_body, blobs, commitments, proofs])` so it still has the tx payload inside of the sidecar? https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4844 is this an accurate diagram of the blob sidecar? I want to ask one question In the consensus specs the validator set is divided into 128 subnet per committee with ~100 validator in each committee. Building upon my narrative on this context The proposer of the block of the slot is chosen from these subnet validators? Does the proposer of the block of the slot receives any reward? After submitting block in slot, proposer of beacon chain block is different? Does the slot block also requires signatur attestation? Or is it only required for beacon chain block? validators are randomly shuffled into attestation committees and _separately_ shuffled into a proposer sequence the proposer receives many consensus rewards, here's a place to start looking at which rewards those are: https://github.com/ethereum/annotated-spec proposer shufflings are stable w/in an epoch and usually stable for the same lookahead as attestation shufflings of 2 epochs not sure about your last question, but each beacon block is signed by the proposer who proposes it attesters then turn around and sign off on this block as the head of the chain (if it in fact extends each attesters view of the head of the chain)

what does this part from the EIP-4844 spec mean?

```On the consensus layer the blobs are referenced, but not fully encoded, ```

during the gossip period, which is when the blob is a blob sidecar, the spec says that the blob tx is wrapped to become `rlp([tx_payload_body, blobs, commitments, proofs])`

so it still has the tx payload inside of the sidecar?
